He ran a clever race, using his head as well as his legs, and in perfect style came away in the last mile to win comfortably ... Lucas, a newcomer, ran well in his first important race in our colours. THE ENGLISH CROSS COUNTRY CHAMPIONSHIP .....

Early in April a 27 strong field tackled the 5 mile road run where experience, in the shape of Arthur Penny, triumphed over men who were to make their names over the coming years – Lucas, Len and Eric Herbert, and one who became “Mr Athletics” himself, Les Cohen.
